pairs.l: 1 — finds the prom a regular feature of social life?
2 — agrees the prom equals unacceptable behaviour?
3 — believes alcohol is not a problem only at proms?
4 — thinks proms have little to do with achievement?
6 — proposes a new kind of celebration?
7 — raises the question of social inequality?
8 — thinks the choice should be left to teenagers?
9 — thinks banning proms could lead to unlawful activities?
10 — sees no problem in the costs of a prom?
11 — puts the responsibility on educational institutions?
12 — thinks a prom mirrors social trends?

r1.exp: 1=F (Faith: 'It has always been part of our culture, a big deal'). 2=B (Ben: 'alcohol and drugs swamp the event... financial decadence and vanity'). 3=C (Carlie: 'teenagers drink every weekend, don't they?'). 4=E (Ethan: 'it's about glamour, not merits'). 5=D (Deanne: 'teenagers seem increasingly alienated, distant and even depressed'). 6=F (Faith: 'I would advocate a big non-prom party instead'). 7=E (Ethan: 'students who just want to celebrate... but cannot afford it'). 8=A (Ashton: 'Give them a chance to choose'). 9=D (Deanne: 'inevitably lead to secret illegal dances and renting tuxedos from unlicensed suppliers'). 10=C (Carlie: 'It's okay if girls want to dress up'). 11=E (Ethan: 'I think schools should set limits and say what is acceptable and make it affordable for all'). 12=C (Carlie: 'proms are a reflection of a generation's current fashions and dance – a reflection of our larger culture').

r13.exp: 'These contemporary EXPLOITS have FOSTERED A RECENT CRAZE' = uspjesi šahista potaknuli suvremenu ludost za šahom = D.

r14.exp: 'Will teach them the importance of TAKING CARE OF THEIR DUTIES' = razvijanje osjećaja odgovornosti = C.

r15.exp: 'Chess will certainly teach him to THINK LOGICALLY AND IMPROVISE' = racionalne odluke i snalažljivost = D.

r16.exp: 'A great way to CROSS OVER BETWEEN having a hard-core curriculum AND giving children the chance to play' = dobra ravnoteža = A (well balanced).

r17.exp: 'OUTBURSTS OF BAD TEMPER when they lose, and sometimes tears' = loše ponašanje pri porazu = C.

r18.exp: 'A £30 chess program can now BEAT THE WORLD CHAMPION' = računala su najbolji šahisti = B.

r19.exp: 'New generation of services starting to take hold. (19)___. Just as email did, this shift promises to rewrite communication.' → H: Countless social networks and messaging services are fighting for a piece of the new world.

r20.exp: 'Email suited logging off/on, checking in bursts. (20)___. Being online all the time has created faster ways.' → F: Whether we are sitting at a desk or on a mobile phone, now we are ALWAYS CONNECTED.

r21.exp: 'Some questions answered without asking. (21)___. Email seems boring.' → A: If you want to know the latest news about your friends, just check their latest status update. Primjer odgovaranja bez pitanja.

r22.exp: 'Half-hour delay seemed bad. (22)___. In a few months complaining about cell phones.' → D: Today, we fuss about it taking an extra few seconds for a text message to go through. Progresija nezadovoljstva.

r23.exp: 'No need for long email about your vacation. (23)___. Instead of few emails to handful, send dozens to hundreds.' → G: If they're interested, they can watch it unfold in real time online. Prijatelji prate odmor u stvarnom vremenu.

r24.exp: 'More ways = more time spent. (24)___. We get lured into wasting time.' → B: This hardly makes us more productive. Direktna posljedica.

r25.exp: 'SOME of which are considered extremely exotic' — 'some' = neki (od kojih su neki smatraju egzotičnima). 'Few' = malo, negativnija konotacija.

r26.exp: 'Hard to have a conversation WITHOUT mentioning food' — 'without' + gerund za negaciju uvjeta.

r27.exp: 'Emphasis on (/) fresh meat' — bez člana ispred nebrojivih imenica u općenitom smislu: fresh meat (nema broji). 'An emphasis on fresh meat' je opća tvrdnja.

r28.exp: 'ALLOW the ingredients to retain their flavours' — 'allow + object + to-infinitive' = dopustiti nečemu da zadrži okus.

r29.exp: 'Famous FOR goose and seafood dishes' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: be famous for = biti poznat po.

r30.exp: 'ON THE OTHER HAND' = s druge strane (kontrast između kantonske i šangajske kuhinje).

r31.exp: 'MAKING great use of chillies' — fiksna kolokacija: make (great) use of = koristiti se (obilno) nečim.

r32.exp: 'Noodles are PREFERRED to rice' — pasivni particip u kopulativnoj konstrukciji: be preferred to = preferira se umjesto.

r33.exp: 'Referred TO as the Cinderella Law' — fiksna kolokacija: be referred to as = biti nazivan/poznat kao.

r34.exp: 'Anger IN/AMONG/AMONGST younger gamers' — 'among(st)' = među, 'in' = kod (u skupini).

r35.exp: 'South Korea, WHICH has one of the world's richest online gaming cultures' — ne-restriktivna relativna zamjenica 'which' (uz zarez).

r36.exp: 'KOREA'S/THE/ITS government' — posvojni genitiv, određeni član ili posvojno 'its'. Sva tri su prihvatljiva.

r37.exp: 'Involved BY holding workshops' — 'by' + gerund za način: by doing sth = radeći nešto.

r38.exp: 'Questioning IF/WHETHER it will prevent' — neizravno pitanje: if/whether = je li, hoće li.

r39.exp: 'FROM the parents' point of view' — fiksni izraz: from someone's point of view = s nečijeg stajališta.

r40.exp: 'Filed the petition ON behalf of parents' — fiksni izraz: on behalf of = u ime, u korist.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA film: vizualni efekti, zvuk, brže, dostupno širem publici. PROTIV: knjiga daje više detalja, vlastita mašta, dublja karakterizacija, originalni autor. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (for and against + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
